description:
**Found during the console-happy-path-mvp gap analysis (2026-07-20), live
TUI.** A drilled-in lane row renders `<id>  <repo>  rank <r>  [status]`
(`crates/console-tui/src/lib.rs` §"A full drill-in line for one work-item:
id, repo, rank, status, and reason") — but not the item's TITLE. Scanning a
12-item backlog to find "the paging bug" means Enter/Esc into the record
modal twelve times. The find-the-item leg of the happy path fails at any
realistic backlog size.

**Expected.** Each lane row includes the work-item title, truncated to the
available width (id and status stay visible; repo may yield space — most
fleets browse one repo's lane at a time). Same for the lane-overview's
per-lane preview rows. Attention rows already carry human-readable text.

**Acceptance (autonomously verifiable).** Renderer tests: a drilled-in lane
row for a fixture item shows the title truncated to width with the id and
status intact; overview preview rows likewise; no panic at narrow widths.

Parent (parent-child edge): livespec-console-beads-fabro-b3k5hi (console-happy-path-mvp epic).
Related: livespec-console-beads-fabro-mwzrby (closed — the record modal this reduces round-trips to).

AUTONOMY TIER: FACTORY (autonomously verifiable — behavior is testable).
Repo: livespec-console-beads-fabro.
title: Drilled-in lane rows render id/repo/rank/status but no TITLE — backlog triage requires opening every item one by one

description:
**Found by exploratory test of the just-closed
livespec-console-beads-fabro-mwzrby (work-item record modal).** Filed as a NEW
bug per maintainer direction — not a reopen, though mwzrby's filed acceptance
explicitly named this path ("same dialog reachable from the Attention
detail"); the shipped change covered the Lanes drill-in only.

**Observed (live TUI, Attention view, 'Blocked: needs-human' item selected).**
Enter opens the pre-existing Command Modal (attach-action picker). For an
orchestrator-sourced attention item there are no attach actions, so the modal
renders COMPLETELY EMPTY — a bare bordered box — while the status bar
advertises "up/down select action | enter run | esc cancel". Two defects in
one:

1. **The work-item record modal is not reachable from the Attention view.**
   The attention list is exactly where an operator meets an item they know
   nothing about; it is the surface that MOST needs the record drill-in that
   mwzrby built for the Lanes path.
2. **Hint-honesty violation** (the same rule the mwzrby follow-up commit
   `185426b` enforces elsewhere): an empty action modal must not open at all,
   and hints must not advertise `enter run` when there is nothing to run.

**Expected.** Enter on an attention item whose work-item record is known
opens the SAME work-item record dialog as the Lanes drill-in (one modal, one
code path). The Command Modal opens only when it has at least one action to
offer; with zero actions the interaction either does not open it or the
surface states honestly that no commands are available. Which ACTIONS belong
in attention context is explicitly deferred to
livespec-console-beads-fabro-vc7lmq / livespec-console-beads-fabro-zweohm
(state-valid verbs); this item is only about reaching the record dialog and
never presenting an empty runnable-action surface.

**Acceptance (autonomously verifiable).** Reducer/renderer tests: Enter on an
attention item with a work-item id opens `WorkItemDetail` with that item's
record; the Command Modal never renders with an empty action list (fixture:
orchestrator-sourced item with no attach actions); hint strings in the
attention context never advertise run/select-action keys when the action set
is empty; Esc returns to the attention list with selection preserved.

**Related:** livespec-console-beads-fabro-mwzrby (closed — Lanes-path record
modal this extends), livespec-console-beads-fabro-vc7lmq,
livespec-console-beads-fabro-zweohm (which actions belong here — deferred),
livespec-console-beads-fabro-l4p3ce (LLM handoff launcher eventually joins
the same dialog).

AUTONOMY TIER: FACTORY (autonomously verifiable — behavior is testable; the
record-dialog surface is already spec-covered by the mwzrby amendment — if
the Attention reachability clause is missing there, a minimal amendment rides
with this change).
Repo: livespec-console-beads-fabro.
title: Record modal unreachable from Attention view — Enter opens the legacy Command Modal, which renders EMPTY for orchestrator-sourced items while advertising 'enter run'

description:
SPLIT OUT of livespec-console-beads-fabro-vc7lmq 2026-07-19. That item's 'immediate defect regardless of design outcome' is severable from its spec-governed detail-pane redesign and MUST NOT wait on a brainstorm. No ratified spec text mandates the attach line ('attach' appears nowhere in contracts.md or scenarios.md), so this half is freeform/factory-tier.

THE DEFECT. fabro_run_id (crates/console-application/src/lib.rs:5496-5501) strips a `fabro:` prefix from the event SOURCE and falls back to event.event_id() otherwise. build_attention_detail (:5363-5374) then formats `fabro attach {fabro_run}` UNCONDITIONALLY at :5370. The renderer is equally unguarded (crates/console-tui/src/lib.rs:2064-2070).

VERIFIED 2026-07-19 — WORSE THAN ORIGINALLY FILED, on two counts:
1. It is not an edge case, it is 100% of cases. attention_snapshots (lib.rs:4886-4892) filters to WorkItemSnapshotObserved, whose sole producer hardcodes source='orchestrator' (source_adapters.rs:1248-1271). The fallback therefore fires on EVERY attention item.
2. The `fabro:` branch is DEAD in production. The fabro adapter emits a BARE `fabro` source (source_adapters.rs:1373), and 'fabro'.strip_prefix('fabro:') is None. Only hand-built test fixtures ever satisfy it. So even a genuine fabro human-gate event would fall back to its event id.

CONSEQUENCE. The operator is shown e.g. `fabro attach evt:orchestrator:<repo>:<work-item>:<version>:snapshot`, which fails with 'No run found matching ...'. Showing a command that cannot work is worse than showing nothing.

FIX DIRECTION. Source the run id from the payload — FabroRunSnapshot::run_id() (used at source_adapters.rs:1367) — rather than parsing it out of the source string; make fabro_run_id return Option<String> instead of falling back; and suppress the attach line when there is no real run, following the `"-"` placeholder convention build_needs_attention_detail already uses (lib.rs:5059-5073). NOTE: naively tightening the guard alone would suppress the line EVERYWHERE, including for genuine fabro events, because of the bare `fabro` source above.

THREE TESTS PIN THE BROKEN BEHAVIOUR and must be retired with the fix:
- crates/console-application/src/lib.rs:7753 (fabro_run_id(&fallback) == 'evt_no_run')
- crates/console-application/src/lib.rs:7669-7675 (attach_command == 'fabro attach evt_pending')
- crates/console-cli/src/lib.rs:2312 (rendered 'Attach: fabro attach evt_demo_1')
Retire the console-cli one AFTER PR #316 merges (same file; trivial rebase).

ACCEPTANCE. No attach command is rendered for an orchestrator-sourced attention item; a genuine fabro-sourced run still renders a working attach; paired must-flag/must-not-flag tests replace the three retired ones; `just check` green.

Filed 2026-07-19 by the impl-dispatch split. Plan thread: plan/operator-surface-redesign/handoff.md. The superseded thread is archived at plan/archive/impl-dispatch/ (see its SUPERSEDED-BY.md).
title: Console surfaces a `fabro attach <event-id>` command that can NEVER work, on 100% of attention items
